# Synthetic workbooks

These minimal XLSX files contain only synthetic data:

- `satispay.xlsx`: one approved wallet expense of EUR 5 on 2026-10-18, with ID `synthetic-1`.
- `satispay-duplicates.xlsx`: the same expense twice, to exercise blocked imports.

Both include the eight required columns: Data, Nome, Descrizione, Importo, Tipo, Stato, Disponibilità and ID. They contain no credentials or personal financial data.
